## About

Joshua Adesina is a full-stack and AI engineer in Lagos, Nigeria. Civil engineering turned into software: Python backends, React frontends. The systems thinking came from structures: load paths, tolerance, and what happens when a piece fails.

He is also a 400-level Civil Engineering undergraduate at Olabisi Onabanjo University (CGPA 3.55/5.00), with SIWES experience at AB SODIYA & ASSOCIATES (August–September 2026) practising AutoCAD drafting under supervision.

Contact: giganticjosha@gmail.com. Replies within two days.

## Selected work

Projects listed on https://www.agaboo.me/:

- HIMAI — An AI tutor for university subjects: explained material, kept what it found, and quizzed you on it. Joshua designed the backend architecture and API, and built the core AI system logic. The deployed service is no longer running. Stack: Python, API design, Railway. Source: https://github.com/BAMZY0030/AI-project-
- Collapse Risk Predictor — Scores the collapse risk of a construction project from its details. Joshua wrote the Scikit-Learn risk model and built the Streamlit interface for a civil engineering capstone. Stack: Python, Scikit-Learn, Streamlit. Live: https://group-5-fo6xokxhv776ojjceed5od.streamlit.app Source: https://github.com/agaboo1981/CollapeRiskModel
- BlockCore — A web3 platform for smart-contract interactions. Joshua wrote the Solidity contracts and the wallet-connection flow, with real-time event listeners. Stack: Solidity, Next.js, web3. Live: https://blockcore.vercel.app/ Source: https://github.com/agaboo1981/blockcore
- Vogue — A fashion e-commerce storefront. Built the responsive Next.js front end with image optimisation and search indexing. Stack: Next.js, Tailwind, Vercel. Live: https://vogue-teal.vercel.app/ Source: https://github.com/agaboo1981/vogue
- Nexus — A fintech interface with interactive yield calculators. Built the Next.js app with dynamic calculators and strict semantic HTML. Stack: Next.js, Tailwind, Vercel. Live: https://nexus-nu-navy.vercel.app/ Source: https://github.com/agaboo1981/nexus
- SALVAGE — A lore site for an orbital extraction shooter. Built with React 19 and Vite: scroll-driven scenes, an automated SEO pipeline, and Playwright E2E tests. Stack: React 19, Vite, Playwright. Live: https://gaming-ecru-phi.vercel.app/ Source: https://github.com/agaboo1981/gaming
- La Dolce Vita — An Italian e-commerce catalogue. Built the Next.js catalogue with optimised image loading and accessible product pages. Stack: Next.js, Tailwind, Vercel. Live: https://ladolcevita-seven.vercel.app/ Source: https://github.com/agaboo1981/ladolcevita
